card.name: Tributo aos Condenados
card.summary: Descarte 1 carta; escolha 1 monstro no campo e destrua-o.

textEvidence.text: Tribute to The Doomed requires the controller to discard one other hand card as its activation cost before the opponent can respond. Destroy one targeted monster on either field, including a face-down monster. Negation or removal of a target does not reimburse the cost; no additional effect or cost is printed.

card.name: Núcleo Escuro
card.summary: Descarte 1 carta; escolha 1 monstro com a face para cima e bana-o.

textEvidence.text: Dark Core requires the controller to discard one other hand card as its activation cost before the opponent can respond. Banish one targeted face-up monster from either field without destroying it. Negation or removal of a target does not reimburse the cost; no additional effect or cost is printed.

card.name: Regresso ao Início
card.summary: Descarte 1 carta; escolha 1 monstro e devolva-o ao topo do Deck do dono.

textEvidence.text: Back to Square One requires the controller to discard one other hand card as its activation cost before the opponent can respond. Put one targeted monster from either field on top of its owner’s Deck; a Fusion returns to its Extra Deck. Negation or removal of a target does not reimburse the cost; no additional effect or cost is printed.

card.name: Fratura Raigeki
card.summary: Descarte 1 carta; escolha 1 carta no campo e destrua-a.

textEvidence.text: Raigeki Break requires the controller to discard one other hand card as its activation cost before the opponent can respond. Destroy one targeted card on either field, including set cards and the Field Zone. Negation or removal of a target does not reimburse the cost; no additional effect or cost is printed.

card.name: Dispersão Maldosa
card.summary: Descarte 1 carta; destrua todas as Armadilhas Contínuas com a face para cima no campo.

textEvidence.text: Malice Dispersion requires the controller to discard one other hand card as its activation cost before the opponent can respond. Destroy every face-up Continuous Trap on both fields at resolution. This does not target. Do not destroy ordinary or set Traps. Negation or removal of a target does not reimburse the cost; no additional effect or cost is printed.

card.name: Purificação de Magia
card.summary: Descarte 1 carta; destrua todas as Magias Contínuas com a face para cima no campo.

textEvidence.text: Spell Purification requires the controller to discard one other hand card as its activation cost before the opponent can respond. Destroy every face-up Continuous Spell on both fields at resolution. This does not target. Do not destroy Field or Equip Spells or hidden cards. Negation or removal of a target does not reimburse the cost; no additional effect or cost is printed.
